newsitem.title: USA: Housecall Medical to expand credit line.
newsitem.headline: Housecall Medical to expand credit line.

text.p: Housecall Medical Resources Inc said on Wednesday that it had expanded its credit facility with Toronto-Dominion Bank from $15 million to $18 million.
The company also said it put in place a $22 million term loan facility with the same bank.
Housecall said it used the term loan facility to complete an acquisition with Healthfirst Inc, a privately owned home healthcare management company.
Housecall paid about $21.8 million in cash and agreed to issue 63,000 shares of its common stock for the acquisition, and assumed about $1.2 million of indebtedness.

"We will continue to talk with the banks and other financial institutions concerning additional future financing, which might be used if we are presented with a particularly attractive strategic acquisition opportunity," said Housecall chief executive Dan Kohl.
Headquartered in Atlanta, Housecall Medical Resources is a provider of home healthcare services in the Southwest.
